children: Prabhudas Lilladher's research report on K P R Mill

KPR reported a strong set of numbers, with revenue growing 18.9% YoY to INR19,397mn, led by robust performance across segments. The company reported EBITDA margin of 25.7%, beating our estimate of 20.0%, and a remarkable 6.4% improvement over Q2FY26. The EBITDA margin improvement primarily reflects improved realizations with gross margin improving by ~500bps. For the first half of FY27, the revenue grew by 14% YoY, and the EBITDA margin stood at 23.0%. The garments volumes during the H127 reached ~90mn pieces (Q2FY27 40.8mn), compared to ~89mn pieces (Q2FY26 39.2mn) in the similar period last year. Textiles revenue grew 16.6% YoY with 20.7% growth in Yarn and Fabric, and 11% growth in garment revenue. The growth was largely realization driven as Yarn and Fabric volume growth was limited to ~2.4%, and garments volumes grew by ~4.0%. Textiles EBIT margin expanded 606bps YoY to 24.9%. Sugar and Ethanol revenue grew 26.9% and 20.5% YoY, respectively, driven by volume growth of 10.2% in Sugar and 24.9% in Ethanol. Sugar realizations increased 15.2% YoY and 18.0% QoQ to INR45.1/kg.

Additionally, given the expected ramp up costs for planned expansion, we expect the margins to moderate in FY28E. Accordingly, while we have marginally revised our revenue estimates for FY28E/29E, our margin expectations remain broadly unchanged. We expect KPR’s revenue/EBITDA/PAT to grow 11.5%/14.8%/14.4% over FY26-FY29E. Following a recent correction in the share price, we upgrade our rating to ‘BUY’ from ‘Accumulate’, with an SoTP-based target price of INR1,289.
